events.text: The company was renamed Atari, Inc.
events.subject: other
events.quote: In May 2003 , after Infogrames , Inc . purchased Hasbro Interactive—which owned the rights to the Atari brand—the company was renamed Atari , Inc .

events.text: Atari, Inc. sold Humongous Entertainment to majority stock holder Infogrames.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In August 2005 , facing financial struggles , Atari , Inc . sold Humongous Entertainment to majority stock holder Infogrames

events.text: Humongous Entertainment was dissolved the day after.

events.text: The Humongous brand and most game assets were transferred to Tommo.

events.quote: the Humongous brand and most game assets were transferred to Tommo on July 19 , 2013

events.text: Tommo re-launched the Humongous.com website.

events.quote: Tommo re-launched the Humongous.com website in January 2014

events.text: Humongous Entertainment went on to re-release several titles under the Humongous Entertainment label into digital distribution channels Steam in April 2014.
